notes: DRAFT for C-STORY-g, v4 (Nov 1). Town visuals stop at Blue (Jay, via the Manager). White is a little worn and hopeful, Yellow cleaner, Orange the approved base art, Green brings the statue, Blue the first gentle homely touches. One full picture per belt. Red to Black have no new art and show the Blue picture. Red gets Tuck the Traveling Helper (placeholder name). Red/Black to Black each have a different PROPOSAL. Text only; art is in PR #396 and code is a Programmer job.
art: incoming-art/town-growth (PR #396): stages/stages.json is the belt-to-picture lookup; the artKey on each belt below matches its names. PR #396 still lists Red to Black as planned pictures; with the cap they use the Blue picture instead.

rules.stateKey: player's own highest earned belt; the phone shows that belt's picture
rules.structure: one complete town picture per belt up to Blue, each in a day and a dusk version, swapped whole. Nothing stacks. Blue is the last picture.
rules.cap: town visuals stop at Blue (Jay, Nov 1). Red to Black show the Blue picture.
rules.sharedSquare: each phone renders its own town; other players are drawn on top and never change it
rules.noShame: no locks, 'coming soon' marks, signs or text on the town, and nothing about other players' belts. A worn or empty bit is allowed when it looks friendly. Words about the town are hopeful and never blame.
rules.dusk: subtle and cozy; every light has a source (a window, a lantern, a lamp post or the Tower)
rules.colour: no red in the town except the brand sign.

decisions.text: The narrowed rule is accepted. Still banned: locks, coming-soon or belt signs, text on the town, and anything about other players' belts. Allowed: worn bits and the empty plinth before Green.
Tuck the Traveling Helper, with a dusk Tower story folded in. Jay then narrowed Tuck to the Red belt only (Nov 1 evening). Red/Black to Black each get a different PROPOSAL for Jay.
A Tuck sprite is OK. The Blue cap covers scenery only.

tuck.name: Tuck
tuck.status: DECIDED (Manager, Nov 1), Red belt only (Jay, Nov 1 evening)
tuck.who: A small traveler with a backpack that is far too big. Friendly, curious and a little shy.
tuck.where: Sits by the bridge. Part of the player's own town, so nothing on screen shows anyone's belt. Once he arrives he stays.
rules: The task is optional. Thanks is the only reward, and nothing is earned that changes how strong you are.
No timers, streaks or counters. Skipping or saying 'later' costs nothing, and Tuck is just as glad to see you.
The manners moment has no wrong answer. Tuck shows the kinder idea gently.
No chat between players, no purchases, nothing about other players' belts.
The dusk story can be heard again any time.
tuck.arrival: Tuck arrives at the bridge, puffing a little under the big backpack, and asks if he can sit.

task.text: Say hello to Sensei for Tuck.

lines.ask: Hi! I'm Tuck. Could you say hello to Sensei for me?
lines.thanks: Thank you! Sensei sounds so kind.

manners.question: Tuck is new. How could we say hello?
manners.kinder: Both are friendly! A smile and a name make a new friend feel at home.

duskStory.title: The Forge of Courage
lines: Long ago, smiths made shields for anyone who needed one.
They sang while they worked, and the forge felt warm.
Courage can be warm, like a small flame.
duskStory.tryThis: Try one brave, kind thing tomorrow.

tuck.reward: A new friend! Tuck the traveler has come to the bridge.
tuck.why: One friend who is glad to see you, a tiny kind job where the kid gets to be the helper, and a story that points toward the Tower.
tuck.artist: A Tuck character sprite is needed (new NPC art; the Blue cap covers scenery only). A small traveler with a big backpack, drawn on top of the Blue town, not baked into the picture. Needs: sitting idle by the bridge, a wave, a small speech portrait, day and dusk lighting. No red.
tuck.programmer: Small and flagged, not part of this PR: one fixed NPC spot by the bridge (no walking), a dialogue box that reuses Sensei's, one optional visit task, one two-choice manners screen with no wrong answer, and the existing story-card viewer for the dusk story. Tuck shows when the player's own highest belt is Red or higher.

proposals.name: Townsfolk Walking and Waving
proposals.pitch: A few neighbours stroll the lanes and wave when you walk by. They are glad you are home.
proposals.growth: Two or three townsfolk who walk slow loops and wave back. They fit the Hall of Echoes: kind greetings come back to you.
lines: I saw you training. Keep going!
proposals.reward: Neighbours are out for a stroll. Wave hello as you pass!
proposals.why: The town feels alive, and a wave back is the best feeling.
proposals.scope: MEDIUM: 2-3 new townsfolk sprites with a walk cycle, and simple looping paths on the Blue picture. Some code. Flagged, not part of this PR.

proposals.name: Dusk Tales with Sensei
proposals.pitch: At dusk Sensei sits on the dojo step and tells a short Tower story. Nothing to do but listen.
proposals.growth: One tale for the Root Library: old roots hold up a library, and every book tells how someone was helped. A kid can hear it again any time.
lines: Come and sit. I have a story about the Tower.
Everyone gets help, and everyone can give it.
proposals.reward: Sensei has a story for you at dusk. Come and sit a while.
proposals.why: A quiet, cozy moment with Sensei, and it adds a piece of the Tower story.
proposals.scope: SMALL: reuses the story-card viewer and Sensei art. It may need one seated pose. If Tuck's dusk story already uses the same viewer, nothing new.

proposals.name: The Town Pup
proposals.pitch: A small friendly pup trots around the square. Tap to say hello. It naps at dusk.
proposals.growth: The pup needs nothing: no feeding, no chores, and nothing sad if you stay away. It fits the Storm Stair: it shakes off the rain and trots back out once the sky is clear.
lines: The pup shakes off the rain. All clear!
The pup curls up for a nap.
proposals.reward: A new little friend is trotting around the town square. Say hello!
proposals.why: Everyone loves a pup. It is just a friend: no care duties, no streaks.
proposals.scope: SMALL to MEDIUM: one pup sprite (idle, trot, nap), a tap reaction and a simple wander. Some code. Flagged, not part of this PR.

proposals.name: The Lantern Walk
proposals.pitch: One calm dusk scene: townsfolk carry small lanterns to the square and gather. No tasks, just a gentle thank-you.
proposals.growth: It echoes the Lost Lightbearer, who carried a small light up the Tower. Sensei and Tuck stand together while the neighbours gather. A kid can watch it again any time.
lines: A little light from each of us.
Thank you for climbing with us.
Look how bright the square is together.
proposals.reward: Tonight the whole town carries lanterns. Come and watch at dusk!
proposals.why: A warm, shared goodbye to the long climb, with no pressure to do anything.
proposals.scope: MEDIUM: a short scripted scene with the townsfolk sprites and small lantern props. It works best if the Red/Black townsfolk proposal is chosen. If not, it uses Sensei and Tuck only (SMALL). Flagged, not part of this PR.

mechanics: Tuck is Red only. Red/Black to Black have PROPOSALS (in `proposals`).

changes.whatYouSee: A little worn but friendly: faded colours, a boarded window, a patched shop-awning stripe and a patched bridge plank, weedy empty flower beds, cloudy water with one koi, a few cracked stones near the empty statue plinth. At dusk the two lamp posts and the dojo and shop windows glow softly; the tall lantern posts stay dark.
changes.dayNote: Soft, faded colours. Quiet and ready for someone to care for it.
changes.nightNote: The windows and the two lamp posts glow, gently. The tall lantern posts are dark.
changes.rewardMessage: Welcome home! This town has lots of room to grow, and you will help it shine.
changes.storyTieIn: Lamp Keeper / Lantern Halls: the lanterns are waiting, and the first small lights are on.

clashResolutions.clash: Spec: the statue is not touched and is part of the start. New arc: the statue is absent until Green.
clashResolutions.resolution: The statue arrives at Green. The plinth is empty at White, Yellow and Orange. The "statue is not touched" rule is dropped.

clashResolutions.clash: Spec: a White-belt town looks complete, the start is the approved base. New arc: White is a little run down.
clashResolutions.resolution: White is the fresh-start town, below the base. The approved base is Orange. White text is hopeful and says "room to grow", never shame.

clashResolutions.topic: No empty plots, locks or signs
clashResolutions.clash: Spec forbids them. The empty plinth, boarded window, patches and weedy beds break it.
clashResolutions.resolution: The rule is narrowed. Still banned: locks, "coming soon" or belt signs, any text on the town, and anything about other players' belts. Allowed: worn bits and the empty plinth, drawn as friendly wear. DECIDED: accepted by the Manager (Nov 1).

clashResolutions.clash: Spec: nine add-on overlay layers that stack. New: one full background per belt.
clashResolutions.resolution: Each belt up to Blue has one picture (`pictureId`). The phone shows the picture for the player's own highest belt and swaps it whole. Nothing stacks. "Changes add up" is replaced by "each picture is complete".

clashResolutions.clash: Spec: lamp posts and a bridge lamp light up at White. New: no lamp reveal.
clashResolutions.resolution: No lamp reveal. The lamp posts glow softly at dusk from White on. The tall lantern posts stay dark, which matches the Lamp Keeper story.

clashResolutions.clash: Spec: beds bloom and a vine on the dojo porch. New: cleaner.
clashResolutions.resolution: Yellow is cleaner: boards and patches gone, beds tidy, water clearer. No vine and no bloom reward. The approved flowers are in Orange.

clashResolutions.clash: Spec: bakery chimney, bread and a long table. New: the base plus a chimney and a basket.
clashResolutions.resolution: Orange is the approved base plus a chimney and a bread basket. The long table and benches are dropped. The smoke moves to Blue.

clashResolutions.clash: Spec: stone path and a stone bench. New: the statue arrives.
clashResolutions.resolution: Green is the statue arriving. The path and bench are dropped.

clashResolutions.clash: Spec: the river turns clear, more koi and a sitting dock. New: statue and light effects, two more koi and lilies.
clashResolutions.resolution: Blue is the first gentle homely touches. The dock is dropped. The river is clearer than White, but "turns clear" is no longer a Blue moment.

clashResolutions.clash: Spec has effects at earlier belts. New: none before Blue, apart from the White lamp posts.
clashResolutions.resolution: Agreed. Effects (smoke, beams, specks, fireflies) start at Blue and stay few. Dusk stays subtle: every glow has a source.

clashResolutions.clash: Spec: Red banners, dummy and brazier; Red/Black chime and bell; Brown tree and book box; Brown/Black glowing Tower, rainbow and window lantern; Black out of scope. New: gentle upgrades, none defined.
clashResolutions.resolution: DECIDED (Manager, Nov 1): town visuals stop at Blue, so Red to Black have no new art and all the old art add-ons are dropped, including the Red banners. Red gets a character instead: Tuck the Traveling Helper (placeholder name). Red/Black to Black get a different PROPOSAL each. Red to Black show the Blue picture.

clashResolutions.clash: The old messages and changeIds point at the old changes.
clashResolutions.resolution: Messages up to Blue are rewritten to match their pictures (Green brings the statue). The old changeIds are replaced by pictureIds. Red to Black lines are Tuck's reward lines. Story tie-ins keep the same story names. Bible references are removed from this file, since faith content lives only in `drafts/content/faith/`.

clashResolutions.clash: The Brown tree beside the placeholder and the placeholder building's use.
clashResolutions.resolution: The Brown tree is gone with the art add-ons. The placeholder building's use is still open (A4-2). The boarded window in White is only wear.

clashResolutions.clash: The spec asked for nine overlays. The art has three of ten stages built.
clashResolutions.resolution: The cap makes it five pictures in all: White, Yellow, Orange, Green, Blue. Built in PR #396: White, Orange, Blue. Planned: Yellow, Green. Red, Red/Black, Brown, Brown/Black and Black use the Blue picture. Until Yellow and Green are built, a belt shows the nearest earlier built picture (README of PR #396).
